name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Bills you export from Tally now send reliably, and if one cannot go out ASVA tells you the exact reason instead of failing quietly.
Fixing a customer's name or number in Tally updates the same customer, so no more duplicate entries with split dues.
New Help button: every screen and every WhatsApp command explained, always one tap away, plus a clearer guided tour and a finish-setup checklist.
If your shop WhatsApp is disconnected, a bold warning now shows on every screen and Send now tells you to reconnect. Full dark mode and a fully English or Hindi app.
